title: Aake seene se mere naiza nikaalo baba
body:
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA, DARD SE APNE TADAPTA HOON BACHALO BABA
GHAR SE JAB RAN MAIN WIDAA HO KE CHALA NOOR-E-NAZAR, DEKHTI THI USE HASRAT KI NAZAR SE MAADAR, LE LIYA NARGHE MAIN PHIR FOUJ-E-JAFA NE BADHKAR, JAB SINA SHUMR NE MARI TOH PUKARE AKBAR
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
SUNKE AWAAZ JAWAN LAAL KI DOUDHE SARWAR, KHAAK PAR KHOON MAIN DOOBA HUWA AAYA JO NAZAR, SADHME SE BETE KA THAR RA GAYA MAZLOOM PIDAR, HATH RAKKHE HUWE SEENE PA JO BOLE AKBAR
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
JAB GAYE DOUD KE MAIDAAN MAIN TANHA MOULA, KHAIMAYE AHLE HARAM MAIN HUWA EK HASHR BAPA, HO KE GASH GIR PADHI MAA DARD KI MAARI DUKHIYA, JAB SUNI BANO-E- NASHAAD NE PURR DARD SADA
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
BYAAH TAK HO NA SAKA MAARA GAYA LAAL MERA, JETEJI DAAGH YE KAISA MUJHE HAI HAATH MILA, KHWAAB SHARMINDA-E- TAABIR MERA HONA SAKA, YAAD AAYENGI MERE LAAL YE AWAAZ SADA
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
KITNE ARMAANO SE PAALA THA PHOOPI NE TUJH KO, HAAL TO AAKE ZARA APNI PHOOPI KA DEKHO, YAAD AAYEGA MERE LAAL TU JAB BHI MUJHKO, DHOONDHNE KE LIYE JAOONGI KAHAAN YE TOH KAHO
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
PAALNE WAALI NE SEHRA BHI NA DEKHA TERA, KARBALA RAAS NA AAYI NA SAFAR RAAS AAYA, CHAND SI CHHATI PA KYA ZULM KA NAIZA KHAYA, MAIN HI MARJATI TERI LEKE BALAAYE BETA
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
DIL KE ARMAAN SAABHI REH GAYE DIL MEIN BETA, JO NA DEKHA THA USE KARBALA AAKAR DEKHA, KAISE KAISE BA KHUDA LAASHE UTHA KAR LAAYA, SUNKE AWAAZ PIDAR KI ALI AKBAR NE KAHA
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
LE CHALE SHAHE DEEN JAB LAASHA JAWAAN BETE KA, LADKHADATE THE KHADAM THOKARRE KHAATE THE SHAH, KHAIME KI SIMT SE YE DEKH KE FIZZA NE KAHA, BIBIYO KHOON MEIN DOOBA HUWA DULHA AAYA
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
NAZAH KE WAQT KA PARWAAZ AJAB AALAM THA, SHEH NE AAGOSH ME SAR BETE KA JISS DAM RAKHA, SHIDDATE DARD SE BAS ITNA HI AKBAR NE KAHA, MERA LAASHA NA MERI MAA KO DIKHANA BABA
<<MINI>>
AAKE SEENE SE MERE NAIZA NIKALO BABA
